title: Release the audit and Dependabot template
goal: The change ships in a template tag and adopters see it as a reconcile row
acceptance: VERSION, CHANGELOG and the reconcile list name the new files and the `audit.dependencies` setting
Released as a minor version with the next template tag; `check:template`, `test:tools` and `check:backlog` pass; the change touches none of the F-102 files
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The usual release steps of a small template change. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
